title: NBA player-season salary history (CSV rows)
description: Drop-in CSV at pipeline/cache/salaries_history.csv. One row per player-season contract year. Season labels match build_vectors.py (e.g. 2023-24).

name.description: Display name as printed on the source (e.g. LeBron James). Normalized by merge_salaries via build_vectors norm_name.

season.description: NBA season label: start year + last two digits of end year (1996-97 .. 2025-26).

salary.description: Annual salary in USD. Accepts integer, float, or formatted string ($47,607,350).

team.description: Optional 3-letter team abbreviation (LAL, BOS) when the source provides it.

cap_pct.description: Optional share of that season's salary cap (0.35 = 35%). Fraction or percent string (35%).
